function: Excluded (above_phy): HG-MADDPG learns task offloading target and ratio plus GER selection; exploration areas come from the Hungarian algorithm; no radio decision is learned (p. 7, p. 10).
notes: Excluded for above_phy (code 4); codes 1 to 3 do not apply (research article; the agents are trained with MADDPG and a diffusion-model actor, p. 9). The learned agent decides computing-task offloading, not a radio function. p. 10: "includes the task offloading target and the associated offloading ratio". p. 7: "the task assignment decisions for the UAV, including computation resource allocation, task offloading ratio, and GER selection". The resource being allocated is the computing capability that a GER gives a UAV, f_{j,u} (p. 6, Eq. 12 and Eq. 20g), not spectrum or power. Exploration areas come from the Hungarian algorithm (p. 9, p. 10 Algorithm 1), and the UAV trajectory follows from the chosen GER, p. 9: "the UAV's trajectory is defined by its movement toward the selected GER", so it is a rule, not a learned decision. The action vector of Eq. (32) on p. 10 holds only the offloading GER and ratio, with no transmit power, beam or channel variable, and transmit power, bandwidth and noise power are parameters of Table III (p. 12).
